description: This file defines the EntitlementConsumptionStrategy interface within the OrangeHRM Leave module. It specifies methods related to handling leave creation, cancellation, entitlement status changes, period changes, and determining leave without entitlement date limits for employees.

classes.name: EntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: Interface that outlines strategies for managing leave entitlements, including creating, cancelling, changing leave periods, and calculating leave balance considerations.

methods.name: handleLeaveCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a leave entry for an employee, considering entitlements and leave dates.

methods.name: handleLeaveCancel
methods.description: Handles the cancellation of an existing leave, updating entitlements accordingly.

methods.name: handleEntitlementStatusChange
methods.description: Handles changes in entitlement status, specifics to be implemented by class.

methods.name: handleLeavePeriodChange
methods.description: Manages changes to the leave period dates, updating relevant entitlement data.

methods.name: getLeaveWithoutEntitlementDateLimitsForLeaveBalance
methods.description: Calculates date limits for considering leave without entitlements in the leave balance for a specific period.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the leave period for a given date, employee, and leave type.
